12.2 Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date.
findings.explanation: The client can end the contract without a reason, but you are paid for the work completed up until the termination date.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date.

findings.explanation: The payment term is 40 days, which is longer than the standard 30 days, delaying when you receive your money.
This means you have 40 days after sending an invoice to get paid, which is longer than the standard 30-day payment terms.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall be paid within 30 days of the invoice date.
